about: Lachute is a city in Argenteuil, in Quebec’s Lower Laurentians, on the North River (Rivière du Nord) northwest of Montréal. A historic downtown, agricultural fair heritage, and a service role for surrounding Argenteuil countryside define the place. Highways 50 and 148 provide quick links to the Montréal region. About 14,000 people live in Lachute.
